title: Soooo Disapointed!
text:
Soooo Disapointed!. I have had one spring whisk for at least 25 years, but I think one of my Grandkids threw
it out by mistake!
I bought this one thinking it was the same as my old one.
(hard to tell from a picture)

There is No comparison with this whisk to my old one unfortunately.
This whisk is cheesy made, but nice handle.The handle is heavier then the whisk!
The wires are So thin and flimsy I could not
get any air into my eggs for a Egg Omlet! All it did was mix them around. I could
have used a fork to do that.
This should go up and down with a little force, and get the eggs frothy and airy,but it didn't even come close.

If any of the two reviewers had my old whisk, they would realize this one is
junk.
Btw, what is the point of leaving a whisk on the counter for show?
Although I doubt this could even sit there for more then 5 seconds with out falling over.

I just finished boxing this up to send back to Amazon.
